vrc.description: A signed W3C Verifiable Relationship Credential (opaque here). Its issuer MUST equal the document proof signer; credentialSubject.id names the subject member; it carries its own DataIntegrityProof.

id.description: Id assigned to the stored relationship (a UUID).

vrcDigestMultibase.description: Digest over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of the stored VRC, for out-of-band integrity checks. The same value vtc/relationships/request reports on issuance and vtc/relationships/list reports per entry, so a member can tie the three together without re-hashing.
